title.en: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
title.zh: Apollo经济学家表示，人工智能为大多数公司带来“零财务回报”

summary.en: "Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech."
summary.zh: “尽管围绕人工智能进行了大量投资和广泛炒作，但该技术为科技以外的美国企业带来了零财务回报。”
